candidate_relations.reason: MPO-ANCA ulcerative vasculitis can phenocopy MPA, but the reference requires methimazole as the cause rather than idiopathic MPA.
Low-titer ANA and anti-SSA do not establish SLE, and the ulcers are a drug-induced ANCA vasculitis rather than lupus.
There is no oral/genital ulceration or pathergy to support Behçet disease.
Polyarteritis nodosa is a medium-vessel vasculitis; the second biopsy shows dermal small-vessel fibrinoid necrosis.
There is no rheumatoid arthritis to support rheumatoid vasculitis.
Polyarteritis nodosa is an incompatible vessel-size and idiopathic diagnosis relative to methimazole-induced vasculitis.
Vasculitis is the parent process but omits the methimazole-induced specificity.
GPA/PR3-associated granulomatous disease is not supported by the cutaneous MPO-positive, organism-negative biopsies.
Lupus vasculitis conflicts with the MPO-ANCA, methimazole-associated small-vessel process.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: lupus vasculitis vs methimazole ANCA vasculitis

candidate_relations.reason: Leukocytoclastic vasculitis describes the histologic pattern but not the methimazole etiology.
Pyoderma gangrenosum is a neutrophilic ulcerating dermatosis without the documented fibrinoid vasculitis.
There is no asthma or eosinophilic granulomatosis phenotype to support EGPA.
Eosinophilic granulomatosis with polyangiitis is an incompatible ANCA-vasculitis subtype here.
Special stains were negative and prior MSSA culture does not establish infection as the ulcer cause.
There are no chondritis features of relapsing polychondritis.
Cutaneous leukocytoclastic vasculitis is a compatible histologic component missing the drug cause.
Wegener granulomatosis is the same incompatible GPA subtype.
Systemic lupus erythematosus is not established and conflicts with the methimazole-ANCA diagnosis.
Erythema induratum is a nodular tuberculid of the calves, not this papulonecrotic drug vasculitis.
Autoimmune disorder is a nonspecific parent and omits methimazole-induced vasculitis.

case_quality_flags: No candidate names methimazole-induced vasculitis despite MPO-ANCA ulcers on methimazole
